name: comp-321
title: Newsletter Subscribe Dialog
description: A compact newsletter signup. A trigger button opens a centred dialog with an email field, a full-width Subscribe button and a short privacy note.
use: The newsletter signup should stay secondary, hidden behind a button until the visitor chooses to open it.
avoid: A modal blocks the page; for a persistent signup use a footer form or an inline field instead.
a11y: Dialog title, description and an email aria-label are set, but Subscribe is type button with no submit, success or error state. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small outlined Newsletter button sits alone on a dark stage. Clicked, it opens a dark rounded dialog with a ring icon, a bold headline, a grey subtitle, an email field with a mail glyph, a wide light Subscribe button and a tiny underlined privacy line.
behaves: The trigger opens the dialog over a dimmed backdrop. The email field accepts typing, the close X dismisses the dialog, and the Subscribe button fills the panel width.
customise: Headline, subtitle, placeholder and privacy copy are hardcoded, so new wording means editing the file; the trigger label and button styling come from shared components.
weight: light: One dialog with a single input and two buttons, animated only on open and close.
demo: Placeholder email hi@yourcompany.com; in one frame the field reads maya@northwind.dev.
issues: Subscribe is type button, so the form never submits anything.
polishWhy: Centred layout, clear type scale and one strong action; the ring icon reads a little ambiguous.
